title: Triggers
note: A Schedule starts a new Task on the Machine at the times you set, in your name, even while your phone is off. A round with nothing to report stays out of the Inbox.
offline: The Machine is offline, so Schedules can't be changed right now.

missing.title: Agent not found
missing.body: This Agent is no longer on this device.
missing.schedule: The Machine no longer has this Schedule

empty.title: No Triggers yet
empty.body: Add a Trigger so the Agent starts work on its own, on a schedule or when idle

editor.footer: Times are on the Machine's own clock. A round is skipped while the one before it is still running or the Budget is used up. Each round runs at most 15 minutes.
editor.textPlaceholder: Check the CI and tell me what failed
editor.goalFooter: With a goal, the Agent notes its progress across rounds and stops the Schedule once it is met

state.suspended: Stopped for good: the key that set it was revoked
state.pausedFailures: Paused itself after 3 failed rounds in a row; turn it on to try again

empty.title: Nothing to do
empty.body: Write what the Agent should do each round.

tooOften.title: Too often
tooOften.body: A Schedule runs at most every 15 minutes, and at least once a week.

badTime.title: Not a time
badTime.body: Write the time as HH:MM, from 00:00 to 23:59.

authenticate.unscope: Make this Schedule of {{name}} ask before running {{entry}}

delete.title: Delete this Schedule?
delete.message: {{name}} stops running it. Tasks it already started stay.

last.busy: {{when}} skipped, the last round was still running

scope.heading: Allowed without asking
scope.footer: A round that comes due on its own has nobody watching, so it asks for no Approval: it does only what the Agent's Allowlist and this list cover. Run it once and approve in that round to add what it needs.

goal.met: Goal met: {{reason}} — turn it on again if it is not

start.title: Starts when…
start.scheduleDetail: Schedule: every few minutes, daily or weekly
start.idleDetail: Idle Work: pieces the Agent does when nobody is asking
